# pindrop

> pindrop helps Kiwi tradies (plumbers, gasfitters, drainlayers, electricians, builders) get found on Google Maps and in AI answers. Based in Hamilton, New Zealand, serving the Waikato and NZ.

## Packages (prices exclude GST)
- Get on the Map: $495 one-off. Google Business Profile setup, updated local directory listings on key NZ platforms, review kit (QR card and ready-to-send text), 45-day review catch-up, first month of review care free. Done in 3 working days.
- Get on the Map + Website: $1,490 one-off. Adds a new mobile-friendly website in the client's name with 12 months hosting.
- Stay on the Map: $99 a month after the free first month. Review care, listing checks and a monthly one-page report. No contract.

## How we work
- Free business check, then a 30-minute chat in person.
- Clients own their Google profile, reviews, website and domain. No pay-per-lead, no contract, money-back guarantee.
- We never use fake or paid reviews and never claim to be from Google.
